concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly names 'permutation importance and attention mechanisms' for interpretability; the spec replaces attention with SHAP without justification. Either add attention-based attribution as an FR or record an explicit assumption that SHAP substitutes for it.

Under-reach: the idea's Expected results require 'uncertainty quantification that captures 90% of true values'. The spec only has a 'confidence_interval' attribute on ModelPrediction with no FR or SC defining how uncertainty is produced or evaluated (e.g. calibration/coverage measurement). Add an FR/SC or an explicit deferral note.

Under-reach: the idea claims identified early-cycle signatures 'outperform standard hand-crafted metrics'. No FR/SC requires a baseline comparison against hand-crafted features (e.g. incremental-capacity features), which is a core claim of the research question. Add a baseline-evaluation criterion or explicitly descope with rationale.
